choose.title: Choose a plan
choose.desc: Compare price, coverage limit, and what is covered, then pick the plan that fits your car.

fill.title: Fill in your details
fill.desc: Enter the insured person and vehicle details. Double-check the plate number and VIN before submitting.

pay.title: Pay the premium online
pay.desc: Confirm the amount, submit the order, and complete the payment. This demo uses a simulated payment flow.

effective.title: Policy takes effect
effective.desc: Once paid, the policy takes effect within one business day. You can follow the order in your account.

driving-license.name: Vehicle licence
driving-license.desc: Used to verify the plate number, VIN, and vehicle type.

owner-id.name: Owner identity document
owner-id.desc: The insured person should match the registered owner; otherwise provide an authorisation document.

registration-certificate.name: Vehicle title certificate
registration-certificate.desc: Recommended for a transfer or a first-time purchase, to confirm ownership.

last-policy.name: Previous year's policy
last-policy.desc: Required when renewing, to confirm the claims record and renewal discount.

premium.question: How is the premium calculated?
premium.answer: The premium depends on the vehicle's purchase price, age, the covers selected, and last year's claims record. The rates shown here are demo figures; the real premium is set by the insurer after underwriting.

refund.question: Can I cancel the policy mid-term?
refund.answer: Yes. After the policy takes effect you can request cancellation and the premium is refunded pro rata for the remaining days. Previous claims do not block the request.

effective-time.question: How soon does the policy take effect?
effective-time.answer: Within one business day after payment. The vehicle must not be driven before the policy takes effect; driving without valid compulsory cover is illegal.

vehicle-types.question: Which vehicles are supported?
vehicle-types.answer: Private cars and non-commercial passenger vehicles for now. Commercial vehicles, special-purpose vehicles, and motorcycles cannot be insured online yet.

invoice.question: How do I get an invoice?
invoice.answer: Once the policy takes effect you can request one from your account. The e-invoice is sent to your account email within three business days.
